name: @yozz.app/worker-web
description: Assets-only Worker serving the YOZZ SPA (../web build). No Hono, no worker code — static hits aren't billed as Worker invocations. VITE_API_URL is baked at build so apps/web/src/vault/api-base-url.ts sees a configured API.

scripts.deploy: VITE_API_URL=https://api.yozz.app pnpm -F @yozz.app/web build && varlock run -- wrangler deploy
